questions.question: What is the theme of Psalm 150, the final psalm?
options: A bitter lament poured out over a ruined city
A desperate plea for rain upon the thirsty land
A lengthy record of the deeds of the many kings
A call to praise God with all kinds of instruments
questions.answer: A call to praise God with all kinds of instruments

questions.question: How does the book of Psalms end?
options: 'The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want!'
'How majestic is your great name in all the earth!'
'Let everything that has breath praise the LORD!'
'Blessed is the man who fears the LORD!'
questions.answer: 'Let everything that has breath praise the LORD!'

questions.question: The psalm names the trumpet, lute, harp, tambourine, strings, pipe, and cymbals for praise.
Praise God in his _____; praise him in his mighty heavens!
Let everything that has _____ praise the LORD! Praise the LORD!
